page.overview:
Who is Minami Nakano?

New Kid (by Kishibe)|species=Human|gender=Female|status=Alive|occupation=Public Safety Devil Hunter (formerly)|affiliation=* Public Safety Devil Hunters (formerly)|image gallery=no|manga_debut=Chainsaw Man: Buddy Stories chapter 2}}Minami Nakano is a character from Chainsaw Man: Buddy Stories. She was a Devil Hunter that was included between Kishibe and Quanxi's love-triangle. But after, she would resign from the Public Safety Devil Hunter.

Minami is described as a young woman with a baby face and dark pixie haircut, as well as having big, round eyes that give the impression of a puppy.

Minami is very outgoing and full of energy, as can be seen when she's being trained by Quanxi. Despite being told to rest multiple times, she keeps trying to push herself to become stronger.

At some point in the past, she was saved by Kishibe after being attacked by a devil.
